name: Mac or Windows
description: Adds a switch to the quick settings menu (top-right of the screen) for the one Mac-or-Windows choice: Mac-style keyboard shortcuts, where copy is Command-C, or the normal Linux and Windows ones, where copy is Ctrl+C. It is the keyboard only - nothing on the screen moves. It runs the same command the terminal does - aq keys mac, aq keys windows - so every way of changing this agrees. Part of AquariusOS.
